title: Introduce cancellable overlay pattern and theme-anchored loading tokens for icon/compact buttons
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Icon and compact buttons currently show full-surface blocking overlays or irreversible spinners when an action is started. This causes layout shifts, prevents keyboard users from cancelling, and produces noisy visual regressions across themes. Goal: define a cancellable, lightweight overlay pattern for icon/compact buttons and introduce a small set of theme-anchored tokens to standardize opacity, color anchoring, and transition timing across light/dark/high-contrast themes. Scope: icon and compact buttons only; not full-width primary buttons in this ticket. Deliverables: token definitions, Figma components, accessibility guidance, implementation spec for engineering, and visual regression test cases.
acceptance_criteria: Design token names and values added to token catalog: button.icon.overlay.opacity, button.icon.overlay.color-anchor, button.icon.loading-transition-ms
Figma components updated with cancellable overlay variant (hover + active + loading-cancellable) and documented interactions
Accessibility guidance documented: keyboard escape/cancel behavior, ARIA live region text, focus restoration rules
Engineering PR implements non-blocking overlay that can be dismissed by a second click or ESC and reverts to previous state without layout shift
Visual regression tests added and baselined for light/dark and high-contrast themes
Rollout plan created: opt-in component flag for 2 weeks then default-on after monitoring
design_notes: Introduce three tokens scoped to icon/compact buttons:
- button.icon.overlay.opacity => default 0.14 (light), 0.20 (dark), 0.28 (high-contrast) to keep overlays lightweight
- button.icon.overlay.color-anchor => uses semantic token 'surface-06' so overlay color tracks theme shifts rather than hard hex values
- button.icon.loading-transition-ms => 160ms for entrance, 120ms for exit to minimize perceived jank

Use a 22x22 circular overlay for 24px icon buttons and 28x28 for compact buttons to preserve hit area. Overlay should be visually separate from spinner — spinner sits above overlay using token z-index.button-overlay < z-index.spinner

Avoid blocking pointer events for neighboring elements; overlay should capture clicks on the button only and expose an escape affordance (ESC / second click) which triggers a soft-cancel state and emits analytics event 'ui.button.loading_cancelled'
implementation_todo: Prototype cancellable overlay in Figma and record micro-interaction preview
Create Confluence spec with token names, usage matrix, and accessibility checklist
Hand off to engineering with examples: icon-button variant with overlay, keyboard flow, and unit test guidance
Engineer to add visual regression snapshots across themes and include Cypress+Percy scenario for spinner entrance/exit and cancel
Run 1:1 with frontend engineer (Ravi) to validate token application and animation timing
Prepare rollout feature flag and monitoring dashboard to track cancel rate and UX regressions
decisions: Do not modify primary/secondary full-width button behavior in this ticket to limit risk
Use semantic color anchoring instead of hard-coded colors so overlay adapts to future theme changes
Expose cancel as both a keyboard ESC and a second click on the same button; both map to a single cancellable API callback provided by the runtime
Keep overlay opacity low to avoid masking icon contrast and pass WCAG 3.0 contrast heuristics for reduced-motion/high-contrast modes

2025-10-30 Ravi Patel (frontend): Reviewed token suggestions. Concern: existing spinner component assumes full disable state; will need small API change to support cancellable mode. Marked dependency ENG-529900.

2025-11-03 Ben Ortega (product): OK with limited rollout behind feature flag. Asked for metrics: cancel-rate, error-rate post-cancel, and any increase in accidental cancels. Added to acceptance criteria.

notes_for_engineers: API change: spinner component should accept prop `cancellable: boolean` and expose `cancel()` callback. When `cancellable` is true, spinner must not set pointer-events:none on the button root.
Telemetry: emit 'ui.button.loading_shown' and 'ui.button.loading_cancelled' with button.variant and theme metadata
Regression: add visual regression cases that toggle between themes and verify focus ring remains visible under overlay
